1: Episode 1
On his first day in a new unit, seasoned detective Singha investigates seven bodies in an abandoned mall — and a witness who claims he can see the dead.
Episode 2
Singha clashes with his former partner, Inspector King, as a ritual symbol ties the murders to a string of unsolved killings from years earlier.
Episode 3
When a mysterious talisman surfaces during the investigation, Singha finds himself relying on Thup's knowledge of the supernatural to explain it.
Episode 4
Tracing the victims to a religious center, Singha and Thup uncover signs of a larger ritual as a malevolent spirit begins attacking others.
Episode 5
As the team reels from a supernatural attack, Singha and Thup pursue a new lead tied to the case while tensions with King begin to resurface.
Episode 6
As the case reaches a major breakthrough, Darin and Sey try to reconcile their relationship. Singha receives disturbing news about the investigation.
Episode 7
When King names Thup the prime suspect, Singha searches for evidence to clear his name. A new ritual killing escalates the "seven bodies" case.
Episode 8
Singha and Thup discover another body with ties to Santi Tham House. Darin begins to doubt King's commitment to finding the true murderer.
Episode 9
As the investigation reaches a turning point, Thup enters a deadly ritual to expose the truth behind the killings while Singha races to save him.
Episode 10
Thup uncovers a disturbing truth about his past that could link him to the murder case. Meanwhile, King opens up to Singha about his feelings.
Episode 11
Thup discovers he is a murderer's son, but Singha vows to protect him as they hunt a culprit planning a new ritual.
Episode 12
Singha and Thup race to stop a ritual killer, only to realize they are the final targets in a deadly sacrifice.
Episode 13
In the final ritual, Singha and Thup must risk their lives to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight.
